totp.title: Two-Factor Authentication
totp.description: Manage your TOTP devices for two-factor authentication.
totp.scanQr: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code to verify.
totp.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this device?
totp.loginDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.manualEntry: Enter this key manually in your authenticator app:
totp.lostDevice: If you lose your authenticator device, contact your administrator. There is no automated recovery — we recommend enrolling more than one device.

encryption.title: Encryption & Backup
encryption.description: Manage database encryption and data backup.
encryption.confirmDescription: This will change the encryption master password. You must use the new password to unlock the system after the next restart. Make sure you remember it.
encryption.changeSuccess: Master password changed successfully. Use the new password on next restart.
encryption.changeNote: Changing the password re-encrypts the database key with a new derived key pair. The database itself is not re-encrypted. Takes effect on next unlock.
encryption.disabled: Database encryption is disabled (DB_ENCRYPTION=false). Encryption settings cannot be modified in this mode.

export.title: Data Export
export.description: Export selected modules as a JSON backup file. Audit logs, sessions, and temporary data are excluded.
export.passwordPlaceholder: Enter your master password to verify
export.noEncryption: Export selected modules as a JSON backup file. Audit logs, sessions, and temporary data are excluded.
export.confirmDescription: This will generate and download a JSON backup of the selected modules. Audit logs and session data will be excluded.

import.title: Data Import
import.description: Import data from a previously exported JSON backup file. This will overwrite existing data in the affected modules.
import.passwordPlaceholder: Enter your master password to verify
import.confirmDescription: This is a destructive operation. All existing data in the following modules will be replaced with the imported data:
import.includeUsersHint: Overwrites the live user table. Required for full disaster recovery / migration; leave off to merge only domain data into an existing tenant. Your own admin row must remain present and active in the backup, or the restore is rejected.
import.confirmIncludeUsersOn: Users, groups, and preferences WILL be overwritten.
import.confirmIncludeUsersOff: Users, groups, and preferences will be skipped.

setup.title: System Initialization
setup.description: Set up database encryption to protect your data.

step1.title: Set Master Password
step1.description: Choose a strong password to encrypt the database. This password will be required each time the system restarts.
step1.bootstrapTokenPlaceholder: Paste the token from server logs
step1.bootstrapTokenHint: Look up BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN in the server's stderr at startup, or read it from <data dir>/bootstrap-token.txt. It is auto-generated each boot and removed once setup completes.
step1.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 12 characters

step2.warningDetail: If you forget your password, this backup key is the only way to unlock the database. Store it securely.
step2.label: Backup Key (for password recovery)
step2.confirm: I have securely saved the backup key
step2.exportRequired: Download or copy the backup key before continuing.

step3.title: Initialization Complete
step3.description: Database encryption is active. Click below to continue.

unlock.title: System Locked
unlock.description: Enter your master password to unlock the system.
unlock.invalidKey: Invalid password or key. Please try again.
unlock.localNote: Decryption is performed locally in your browser. Your password and key never leave this device.
unlock.rateLimited: Too many unlock attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
unlock.systemUnavailable: Database is unavailable. Contact an administrator.
unlock.metaMissing: Encryption metadata is missing on this server.
